item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 2/25/2026
item.description: Bob talks to Southern Miss outfielder Ben Higdon after the Golden Eagles’ big win over Alabama at The Pete last night. Plus, Assistant USM baseball coach Travis Creel recaps the game and looks ahead to this weekend’s series against Louisiana Tech in Ruston.

item.title: Spider monkeys smuggled into U.S. in lunch boxes now housed at Hattiesburg Zoo
item.description: Four juvenile spider monkeys that were smuggled into the U.S. inside lunch boxes are now being cared for at the Hattiesburg Zoo. Zoo officials announced that each went through a quarantine period before being introduced to their outdoor habitat alongside a senior adult male spider monkey that has been at the zoo for several years. item.title: Bill addressing Mississippi workforce shortage through community colleges advances
item.description: Legislation aimed at using Mississippi’s community colleges to address a growing workforce shortage continues to move through the state capitol. Senate Bill 2522, which establishes the Upskill Mississippi Grant Program, received near-unanimous bipartisan support in its originating chamber, where it passed on a 49-3 vote. item.title: T&L Extra: D1Baseball’s Eric Sorensen Previews the Amegy Bank College Baseball Series
item.description: Mississippi State heads to Arlington for what could be a massive early season opportunity, as the Bulldogs prepare to face Arizona State, Virginia Tech, and the number one team in the land, UCLA. Brian Hadad reached out to D1Baseball’s unofficial western bureau chief Eric Sorensen to get a preview of the weekend ahead.
